name: 3DViewMaker v1.55
description: Interactive 3D model viewer and turnaround sheet generator with automatic STL loose-part mesh splitting, orthographic framing, turntable video recording, vertex dimensioning, batch/exploded-view assemblies, extended LookDev materials with draft angle analysis and center of mass balance checking, cross-section capping with stencil solid caps, clipping planes, GTAO/AA post-processing, volume/cost estimation, and Google Drive integration.
